_about: admin1-spec.json — the rows of the LAZY ADMIN-1 LAYER, atlas/data/admin1.bin (docs/atlas-v2-admin1-layer.md §3.1). One row per country whose states or provinces
the core (topology.bin) does NOT carry; a country the core already carries (the US, China, Russia, the UK) never appears here — two sources for one state would be two
entities with one id (§5). build-admin1.js reads ONLY the geometry of Natural Earth 10m admin-1 (ne-10m-admin1, public domain) for a row's units, through the committed
extract admin1-source.json; every name, kind, ISO code and Wikidata item is DECLARED here, never taken from Natural Earth's attributes (its `type_en` is wrong on several
Indian units — Himachal Pradesh "Union Territory", Gujarat blank — and four of its ISO codes and two of its Wikidata items are stale; the Russia plan's rule).
A unit's `ne` is Natural Earth's `iso_3166_2` for the row whose geometry it takes (absent = the same as `iso`). `name` is the name the card plan uses
(docs/india-geography-card-plan.md, the English Wikipedia article's name without its disambiguator); `kind` is the unit's constitutional kind; `iso` is its CURRENT
ISO 3166-2 code and `qid` the Wikidata item that carries that code (P300), both as Wikidata's query service answered on 2026-11-14 for every item with an `IN-` code;
`wiki` the item's English Wikipedia sitelink. The entity id is `adm1:<a3>:<iso, lower case>`, the core's own scheme. A correction to Natural Earth is listed under
the country's `corrections` with its reason. Rows are in the card plan's running order (gin-001 … gin-036); the order decides nothing else.

corrections.reason: ISO 3166-2:IN changed four codes in 2023 (Chhattisgarh IN-CT to IN-CG, Odisha IN-OR to IN-OD, Telangana IN-TG to IN-TS, Uttarakhand IN-UT to IN-UK); Natural Earth 5.1.1 (2022) has the old ones and Wikidata the new. The ids use the current codes; `ne` names the row whose geometry is taken.

Natural Earth names the CITY items for two union territories (Delhi Q1353, Chandigarh Q43433); the items that carry the territories' ISO codes are the National Capital Territory of Delhi (Q9357528) and the Union Territory of Chandigarh (Q120971341).

Natural Earth's fourth ring of Puducherry is not Mahe: it lies 35–50 km north of the enclave (11.97–12.15° N, 75.22–75.40° E, round Taliparamba in Kerala's Kannur district) and covers 125 km² against Mahe's 9 km² (Mahe is at 11.70° N, 75.54° E). That ring is dropped (`dropRings`), so its land is Kerala's; Puducherry is drawn as its other three enclaves (Puducherry, Karaikal, Yanam) and Mahe is not drawn until an open source for its outline is pinned.

Natural Earth's type_en calls Himachal Pradesh a union territory and leaves Gujarat blank; both are states. Every kind here is declared: 28 states and 8 union territories, the Government of India's count since 26 January 2020.
